rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red, red blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Philatelie
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (1989).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Union e.G. in 2000 as 'Philatelie'.
rows.Bloom: Orange-red, streaks, stripes, flecks. [Red and white, stripes.] Striped and spotted orange red and yellow. Cream-red. None / no fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Compact, upright. Dark green, leathery foliage.

Height: 28" to 6' (70 to 185cm).

colour: Orange-red, streaks, stripes, flecks. [Red and white, stripes.] Striped and spotted orange red and yellow. Cream-red.
